branch.unsaved: Has changes that are not saved as a version

save.title: Save a version
save.description: A version is a point that you can come back to. Say what you changed.
save.label: What did you change?

start.title: Start a new change
start.description: A change is a copy of the thesis to try something in. The main line stays as it is until you merge the change back.
start.label: Name of the change

discard.title: Discard “{{name}}”?
discard.description: The change and everything you did in it will go. The main line is not touched. This cannot be undone.

history.title: Version history
history.description: The versions of “{{branch}}”, the newest first.
history.restoreBody: The documents become what they were in “{{label}}”. It is saved as a new version, so nothing in the history is lost. Changes that you did not save are replaced.

compare.title: What changed in “{{label}}”
compare.description: Compared with the version before it.
compare.first: This is the first version, so there is nothing before it.

merge.title: Merge “{{name}}” into the main line
merge.upToDate: The main line already has everything that this change has.
merge.fastForward: The main line has nothing that this change lacks, so it only moves up to this change.
merge.clean: The main line and this change can be merged without a conflict.
merge.needSave: Save a version first. A merge uses the versions of the change, and not what is typed now.
merge.conflicts_one: {{count}} conflict needs your choice. Nothing is written until it has one.
merge.conflicts_other: {{count}} conflicts need your choice. Nothing is written until each one has a choice.

conflict.blocks: Both sides changed the same part of {{title}}
conflict.document: {{title}} was deleted on one side and changed on the other

revert.title: Discard what you typed?
revert.description: The documents go back to the latest version. What you typed since is lost, and this cannot be undone.
